d.en: Inu X Boku Secret Service Episode 13
d.jp: 妖狐×僕SS 御狐神くん変化 / スイッチ / おままごと
d.synopsis: Unaired episode released with the seventh volume of the Blu-ray & DVD. It consists of three short episodes newly written by the manga author Fujiwara Cocoa. Fujiwara also designed a new character called Hana-chan for the episode.
